offers_products.reason: Sells land, homesites and homes it develops, plus commercial property in Northwest Florida.

offers_services.reason: Operates hotels, resorts, clubs, weddings and events, and leases commercial space as asset manager.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells homes and homesites to households and hotel and resort stays to vacationers under the Watersound brand.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Leases commercial space to businesses and sells land to homebuilders and commercial developers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue mostly from one-off land and home sales plus hospitality stays; leasing is recurring but smaller.

cyclical_demand.reason: Residential lots, vacation hospitality and commercial development are discretionary and easily postponed in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Largest part is homesites, homes and land sales plus commercial leases; typical sale is large and infrequent.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from land, real estate, leased properties and hotel assets rather than staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are homebuyers, vacationers, homebuilders and small-to-mid commercial tenants, not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns hotels, resorts, clubs, leasable commercial buildings and large land holdings needing ongoing development capital.
